name: 13 Leaf Clover Axe
description: An axe harnessed with the notorious 13 Leaf Clover. A four leaf clover might have been more preferable…

name: 8 Bit Artix's Axe
description: Following the great Undead Assault, the holy Axe of the Paladin Artix was cursed and infused with pure darkness to create the Shadow Reaper of Doom. This terrible weapon of unstoppable dark power has at long last been purified.

name: 8-Bit Battleaxe
description: The bit and the byte and the binary numbers merged to form… the 8-bit Battleaxe. Battle On!

name: 9001 SHU Keytar
description: If you can't stand the heat… turn the speaker volume down," - Jimmy Henchicks.

name: A Dino Bone
description: Everybody wants a bit of dinosaur bone to wind a piece of string around, and everybody wants a rockin' rock to swing around town! Rock on!

name: A Rock
description: Everybody wants a rock to wind a piece of string around, and everybody wants a rockin' rock to swing around town! Rock on!

name: Abaddon Exterminan
description: A brutal ax forged exclusively for the Spineback Abaddon and its growing brood Lower lifeforms, including older generation Dreadspiders, can't lift its weight. They will all face extermination.

name: Abaddon's Orb Weaver Axe
description: This axe is powered by an enchanted spider who never leaves the blade. The axe's spider poisons its enemy with black magic before feasting on their very life essence!

name: Abomineator Axe
description: Good for slicing potatoes, carrots, the flesh of your enemies, green beans.

name: Absym Axe
description: A relic from a time before the light; when time was not yet known, and worlds had yet to exist…

name: Abyssal BeastMaster's Great-Axe (0 AC)
description: The bone-chilling armaments of the Abyssal BeastMaster are made of materials that originate aboveground. For a time, their nature will repel the beasts that lurk below until the abyss claims you as its own.

name: Abyssal BeastMaster's Great-Axe (AC)
description: The bone-chilling armaments of the Abyssal BeastMaster are made of materials that originate aboveground. For a time, their nature will repel the beasts that lurk below until the abyss claims you as its own.

name: Abyssal Frost's Massacre (0 AC)
description: Not knowing what they were, vikings hunted and killed Fiends, dooming their fates. Their Shamans foretold utter demise at the hands of their supposed prey, so they must live wild and indulgent with the time they have left.

name: Abyssal Frost's Massacre (AC)
description: Not knowing what they were, vikings hunted and killed Fiends, dooming their fates. Their Shamans foretold utter demise at the hands of their supposed prey, so they must live wild and indulgent with the time they have left.

name: Advent Darkness Axe
description: This axe was a gift to a worthy hero who promised to rid the Northlands of SHadow. Countless fell to the tempting promises of monstrous interloper, and had to be purged. Screams haunt its blade.

name: Agony Chains
description: Truly worthy of its name, this axe shocks your enemies as it rends their flesh.

name: Albedo Battle Axe
description: Galactic guns and stellar swords are no match for a massive battle axe!

name: Amber Axe of The Harvest
description: Due to this axe's soft, warm glow, it can also be used as a nightlight.

name: Amethyst Axe
description: It may look too sparkly and pretty too take into battle, but this gem will knock you across the room!

name: Amethyst Crystal Axe
description: If the summer's excessive humidity deals damage to your HP, then an ice crystal scepter like this is ideal for cooling off and dealing with pesky fire elementals. Just don't stare too closely at its center.

name: Amethyst Pickaxe
description: Relics from a lost society, these pickaxes belonged to the Amethyst Elven Clan who use to dwell in the forest before it was corrupted by Chaos. Now all that is left from this great race are these legendary weapons.

name: Amethyst Skulls Guitar
description: Skulls and bones and ROCK AND ROLL! Happy Friday the 13th, Hero!

name: Ancient Axe of the Archipelago
description: Kartos si Botax has gifted you with an axe that has a strong soul to eradicate evil and defend the truth.

name: Ancient Legion Axe
description: You've defeated Blightbringer's Shadow Man and witnessed the beginning of the Undead Legion through the eyes of its first General! Wield this axe well, Warrior!

name: Angel Axe of Light
description: This axe was made to strike down evil without mercy.

name: Anti-Kaiju Axe (AC)
description: You can take down the Kaiju with a thousand cuts, or one well-placed whack. It's a matter of preference.

name: Anti-Kaiju Axe (Non-AC)
description: You can take down the Kaiju with a thousand cuts, or one well-placed whack. It's a matter of preference.

name: Apatheia Cleaver
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Apatheia Halberd
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Apocalyptic DeathLord's Axe
description: To ascend to the greatness you deserve, many sacrifices will be required:

name: Apocalyptic Draconian Axe
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic Draconian BattleAxe
description: An ancient prophecy fortells: when the dracoliches rise, the end of the world is near… Which side you will battle on when hordes of undead dragons fall upon Lore?

name: Apocalyptic LichKing's Axe
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Apocryphal Shadow Executioner
description: An axe once used to purge those who were lost to the Shadows. It re-emerges with new purpose, beheading those who betray Doom.

name: Arbiter's Crusher
description: Paladins are known to be good, trustworthy, and fair. The Sanctified Arbiters are an corps of Paladins who travel the land dispensing justice and righting wrongs.

name: Arc Att-Axe
description: This is the guitar you wielded on the mountaintop to save Arc Attack! It still has some scorchmarks from where the lightning struck it repeatedly during your performance.

name: Arc-Lightning Guitar
description: Arcs of Lightning SHOULD shoot out of this guitar, but Sam hasn't around to wiring it yet.

name: Archfiend Annihilator of Death
description: (Item does 40% more damage to all tagged monsters when equipped.)Following the events of Vordred's defeat, Vulnios, who was an agent for the Nulgath Nation picked up the Shadowreaper of Doom and modified it with his twisted powers. After his discharge, Nulgath finally gives you the axe.

name: Archfiend Dragonlord's Axe
description: The dragon doesn't control you… you control the dragon.

name: Ardent Axe of Friendship
description: Watch this glowing heart blade slice through the air, decimating lackluster passion and hatred. Merely holding this axe will inspire love, poetry and sonnets. Beware, though, as others may just flock to you.

name: Arena Rockstar Guitar
description: A deadly axe, ready to rip it up.

name: Artix's Golden Paladin Axe
description: The Paladins of Lore salute you, Hero. May your battles against the undead be always victorious! Battle ON! Axe gives +30 damage to undead.

name: Artix's Scribble Axe
description: This is what happens when Miltonius draws with his left hand. The axe gives one mean paper cut. (Disintigrates in one week.)

name: Artix's Undead Axe
description: This super-sharp axe has bean a favored weapon of Paladin Artix Kieger since 2005. (Imported from the original AdventureQuest)

name: Ascended Light of Destiny
description: To reward you for obtaining Drakath's Armor, we're giving you another Blinding Light of Destiny! (With an added 5% Rep bonus!)

name: Ashaan Arch Axe
description: This mystical axe harnesses the power of all that is Good and Holy in the land of Lore with every blow that it delivers!

name: Ashbringer's Battleaxe
description: This ferocious battleaxe once belonged to the great Dragonlord, Ashbringer, who became legend as she saved Lore time and time again beside her dragon, Fusillanth. Now, it has found it's way to you.

name: Astravian Mercenary's Axe
description: A common tool used by the mercenaries of Astravia.

name: Astravmalgam Cyst Axe
description: A monstrous dead fly was ripped apart and 'artistically" stitched back together to craft this axe. It's stench will knock your enemies out before you have a chance to strike them.

name: Atlas Lion's Judgement
description: The axe runs red with the Atlas Lion's own blood. A utopia needs sacrifice, and only true heroes are willing to dedicate everything they have to it. Fittingly, only one King is destined to rule a world unmarred by Evil.

name: Auroral Edge Axe
description: Ring in the new year with class AND style!

name: Automated Axe
description: Leaving messages with the blade of your axe!

name: Avian Grace
description: Silent as night, sharper than any human made blade, these feather come from a special bird, rare and unseen by all but those who learn to kill it bird. When plucked, these feathers create one of the most incomparable, offensive weapons this side of Lore.

name: Awakened Axe of Golmoth
description: The Dragon Princes of the Djinn Realm are feared among all of the draconic species on Lore. They possess a power rarely seen in our world… and not at all understood.

name: Awakened Death's Requiem Axe
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honors the dead. Inhabiting this axe are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Awakened Fiend Axe
description: The axe sneers, pulsing power siphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Fiend Dual Axe
description: The axe sneers, pulsing power siphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Axe Axe +15
description: Axe me no more questions and I'll tell you no more lies… The truth is, this axe does 15% more damage to undead when equipped.

name: Axe Me Nicely
description: This adorable little one-eyed doll head has seen better days. The axe blade itself is fashionably hidden through your once beloved nursery toy.

name: Axe of Absolute Death
description: Just the slightest of grazes can cripple foes.

name: Axe of Bone-Shattering
description: As Vordred once said, "MORE SKULLS!"

name: Axe of Boneshattering
description: This axe, laced with the bones of bones of your past trophies, will be the perfect tool for skinning the wings off of dragons!

name: Axe of Boneshearing
description: As Vordred once said, "MORE SKULLS!"

name: Axe Of Cerberus
description: Remember: it's not those entering The Underworld that need to be feared.

name: Axe of Chaos
description: Chaos' all seeing eye will be right there with you as you cause destruction and mayhem throughout Lore!

name: Axe of Creation
description: In response to the Axe of Ruin, this weapon appeared in LightGuard Keep's armory. To this day nobody knows from whence this blessed, shining weapon sprang.

name: Axe of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Axe of Feeling
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: This axe by Disturbed Indestructible radiates love, kindness and…pinkness. The radiant gold at the center is symbolic of the purity of the loving heart. Bust an enemy with love today.

name: Axe of Frozen Agony
description: Forged from Dage's black sleet, this axe corrupts anyone it hits… if it doesn't kill them first.

name: Axe of Frozen Peace
description: Toil on the battlefield and dispense trouble everywhere you go! Note: Bubbles, bubbles not included.

name: Axe of Golmoth
description: The Dragon Princes of the Djinn Realm are feared among all of the draconic species on Lore. They possess a power rarely seen in our world… and not at all understood.

name: Axe of Hauberk
description: A unique concept for an axe, the Hauberk's blade has seen many battles but still remains incredibly sharp.

name: Axe of Holocene
description: This massive axe reflects Mount Mafic's ruthless might in appearance and in combat.

name: Axe of Indictment
description: Who needs handcuffs to apprehend a culprit when you have a massive, dual-edged axe of justice at your side?

name: Axe of Isthmia (AC)
description: An axe carved from the stone foundations of an undersea paradise. A leviathan died and petrified, allowing for the birth of this utopia. It gives its kin weapons so they won't forget its existence.

name: Axe of Isthmia (Non-AC)
description: An axe carved from the stone foundations of an undersea paradise. A leviathan died and petrified, allowing for the birth of this utopia. It gives its kin weapons so they won't forget its existence.

name: Axe of Light
description: A massive axe used by some of the Paladins of Lightguard Keep.

name: Axe of Love
description: Watch this glowing heart blade slice through the air, decimating lackluster passion and hatred. Merely holding this axe will inspire love, poetry and sonnets. Beware, through, as others may just flock to you.

name: Axe of Malevolence (0 AC)
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Axe of Malevolence (AC)
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Axe of Many Flames
description: What do you do when there are too many flames? Grab more marshmallows.

name: Axe of Minar
description: Forge from bronze and modified with an enhanced core, the mysterious Axe of Minar is inspired by--and named after--your fellow player, Minar!

name: Axe of Randor
description: Randor the red likes axes - and he likes red! To celebrate the passing of another year of his own existence, Randor has chosen to share these passions by combining them into one awesome weapon for you!

name: Axe of Ruin
description: In an evil ceremony, several weapons were called into this world from a far darker place. This was the first of the evil set of weapons to arrive in our world.

name: Axe of Songs
description: Rock on with the Axe of Songs!

name: Axe of Songs Attack Guitar
description: ATTACK!

name: Axe of the Black Knight
description: It's said this weapon of shadows can break armor… and souls!

name: Axe of the EbilCorp Knight
description: It's said this weapon of shadows can break armor… and souls!

name: Axe of the Evil Eye
description: This axe's strange, other-worldly eyes can see well beyond the mortal plane. Some say they can see beyond the veil of time of its owner's death.

name: Axe of the Galvanic Chronomancer
description: The galvanic currents flashing off this axe are used by the Chronomancer of Energy to drive charged ions into the tissues of their foes.

name: Axe of the Infernal Defiler
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this axe. It is a testament to your victory in the Infernal Arena.

name: Axe of the Light
description: For honor… for glory… we BATTLE ON!

name: Axe Of The Piercer
description: You have to crack those bones somehow.

name: Axe of the Prospector
description: The perfect weapon to use when stuck between a rock and a hard place.

name: Azureblood Battleaxe
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed blood descendants.

name: Azureblood Great Axe
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed blood descendants.

name: Ballooning Light of Destiny
description: If you love the Blinding Light of Destiny, but don't want all the fuss and bother of cleaning and sharpening… here's the one for you! WILL GO RARE!

name: BallyCool's Festive Axe
description: Ballyhoo was beside herself with excitement for the holidays. Even her favorite axe got a festive update.

name: BallyCool's Platinum Axe
description: Ballyhoo was beside herself with excitement for the holidays. Yulgar gifted her this platinum version of her axe to help celebrate.

name: BallyCool's Platinum Holiday Axe
description: Ballyhoo was beside herself with excitement for the holidays. Yulgar gifted her this platinum version of her axe to help celebrate.

name: Ballyhoo's Axe
description: If this is Ballyhoo's axe… then what is she wielding right now?!

name: Ballyhoo's Polished Axe
description: *No description*

name: Barbaric Skull Cleaver
description: The fallen enemies of the BoneBreakers now adorn their weapons of war. These symbols of death loom over the Barbarians, and ignite their thirst for battle. They will be the dealers of death. Not its pitiful victims.

name: Bark Basher
description: Absolute destruction doesn't just grow on trees… oh wait.

name: Battle Axe of the Bayou
description: Eco-friendly never looked more fierce!

name: Battle Berimbau
description: This Brazilian musical bow has been equipped with an axe blade. Now your music won't just please your listeners, it can slay whole crowds!

name: Battle Chaoaxe
description: When you fuse Chaos with a menacing Battleaxe… you get the Battle Chaoaxe!

name: Battle Pickaxe
description: Pick your battles, THEN axe questions.

name: Battle Scarred Traveler's Axe
description: Good for slashing ahead, stabbing at both ends, and slicing your bread.

name: Battleaxe
description: While some axes are for chopping wood, others are made for war. This particular axe will chop down a lot more than trees.

name: BattleAxe of DOOM
description: This weapon was originally used by the Champion of Darkness. Due to the potent dark energy of this axe, a single cut could be fatal. Use it wisely.

name: Battleaxe of Evil Intent
description: This axe pulses with dark energy. Let's hope that means bad news for your foes and not for you!

name: Battleaxe of the Angaz
description: This massive axe was forged from the strongest iron ore. It's amazing to think that a Dwarf once wielded this monstrosity.

name: Battlegear E Axe
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Battlegear P Axe
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Battleon Warbeast Axe
description: When towers topple, their stone and steel are repurposed to arm the people. Until this land becomes barren and blank, Battleon will never know true defeat.

name: Batwing Axe
description: A metal axe that has been meretriciously carved to resemble that of a bat. A Vampire's most prized possession; a Lycan's antagonizing enemy.

name: Bear Clawed Axe
description: You fashion a claw-axe out of the corrupted bear. But it seems to have a mind of it's own. You're not sure but it seems to be changing shape sometimes.

name: Bearded Axe of Nulgath
description: This weapon can be anything Nulgath decides.

name: Beetle Bass
description: After a hard day's fight, all you need is this axe! Travel across the universe with your new bass and and always be prepared in battle… of the bands.

name: Berserker Battle Axe
description: A traditional stone-cut battleaxe that gave the Darkblood an edge against heavily-armed rivals for centuries until it was lost in history. Nowadays, after much effort from a curious hero, it has found its way back.

name: Berserker's Fiendish Brutalizer (0 AC)
description: This axe is the most durable the Nation has to offer, and for good reason. If their Berserker breaks their weapons in the middle of a fight, they'll grab the nearest Fiend and use them as a bludgeon to compensate.

name: Berserker's Fiendish Brutalizer (AC)
description: This axe is the most durable the Nation has to offer, and for good reason. If their Berserker breaks their weapons in the middle of a fight, they'll grab the nearest Fiend and use them as a bludgeon to compensate.

name: Big Wolf Slaying Axe
description: A big bad axe to slay big bad wolves… and other things. Simple but effective!

name: Bio Berserker Axe
description: You unlocked this sword by supporting Biobeasts! The trapped creatures of the lab thank you![

name: BitterHeart Axe
description: A blade as cold as your icy heart.

name: Black Electric Guitar
description: Basic black guitar. Goes with anything!

name: Black Electric Guitar Attack
description: Basic black guitar. Goes with anything!

name: Black Light of Destiny
description: Following the great Undead Assault, the holy Axe of the Paladin Artix was cursed and infused with pure darkness to create the Shadow Reaper of Doom. This terrible weapon of unstoppable dark power has at long last been purified. Then painted black.

name: Blackhole Light of Dread Space
description: Don't dread the evil in front of you. Look it square in the eye and yell "BATTLE ON!"

name: Blacksteel Dragon Axe
description: The obsidian blades of this axe are coated in a super-heated dragonbane coating, specially preparee to /slay ANY of Lore's dread dragons!

name: Blades of Order Axe
description: Wielded by the Blades of Order, this trusted axe has been used to defend Lore and the Amberheart Tower for millennia.

name: Blazing Light of Destiny
description: A righteous axe tempered in the flames from a volcano's scar. It vanquishes the Shadows, and punishes them for their evils. Their scars will burn even when they slink away to hide in darkness.

name: Blight Oracle Axe
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. Most will viciously rebuke the truth.

name: Blinding Axe of Destiny Lite
description: For heroes who need to train up their STR before wielding the real axe.

name: Blinding Axe of Purity
description: Grab your axe and go… because the time has come to ROCK the world of Lore, just like Synderes!

name: Blinding Box of Destiny
description: Boxadins are the eco-friendly protectors of… BOXES! This axe is using recycled cellophane tape to hold the blades on.

name: Blinding Edge of Obsidian (AC)
description: A familiar looking battleaxe that is depleted of all its spirit power. Is there a way to empower it? Maybe you'll find out in the future. (Forged by the legendary weaponsmith, Feraligatr)

name: Blinding Edge of Obsidian (Non-AC)
description: A familiar looking battleaxe that is depleted of all its spirit power. Is there a way to empower it? Maybe you'll find out in the future.

name: Blinding Hurp of Derpity
description: ERMAHGERD IMMA BATTLE AXE! Swishity swish choppity chop i do good werk YAAAAAY =D

name: Blinding LEDestiny
description: Cyber Paladins call on the power of the LED instead of normal light!

name: Blinding Light of Chaos
description: Could this be a corrupted version of Artix's axe?

name: Blinding Light of Deliciousness
description: Of COURSE Artix is going to cut the cake with the Blinding Light of Deliciousness!

name: Blinding Light of Destiny (Axe)
description: You've battled many monsters and saved Lore countless times! The Blinding Light of Destiny may only be wielded by the strongest, most tenacious of Heroes. Artix has no doubt that you have earned this honor!

name: Blinding Light of Destiny Handle
description: Following the great Undead Assault, the holy Axe of the Paladin Artix was cursed and infused with pure darkness to create the Shadow Reaper of Doom. This terrible weapon of unstoppable dark power has at long last been purified.

name: Blinding Light of DragonFable
description: The Blinding Light of DragonFable commemorates the love Artix bears for all of his games!

name: Blinding Light of Dread Space
description: Don't dread the evil in front of you. Look it square in the eye and yell "BATTLE ON!"

name: Blinding Pink of Destiny!
description: You've battled many monsters and saved Lore countless times. Now you must save Beleen from Artix's wrath when he sees what she has done to his Blinding Light of Destiny!!!

name: Blood Axe Of Destruction (1)
description: Embrace the shadows but beware… the light of the celestial realm can harm you!

name: Blood Axe Of Destruction (2)
description: Embrace the shadows but beware… the light of the celestial realm can harm you!

name: Blood Axe of the Underworld
description: When they said "paint the town red" I don't think they meant with blood…

name: Blood Legion Battle-Axe
description: You've sworn allegiance to Laken, you are now members of the elite Blood Legion. Time to take down Dage's Legion!

name: Blood Lord's Wrath
description: The metal edge to this axe is just decoration. The true cutting power comes from the magical aura infused within the weapon. But what decoration!

name: Bloodstone Battle-Axe
description: Bloodstone is not red, as the name implies. It is a dark green, which belies the fierceness of those who employ it. In potions, it can enhance telepathic and animal communication powers.

name: Blue War Guitar
description: A deadly axe, ready to rip it up.

name: Blunt Brass Basher
description: Skyguard SMASH! Bludgeon those bad guys into unconsciousness when you wield that bulky basher!

name: Boarding Axe
description: This axe was designed for latching and boarding enemy vessels, then chopping them to flotsom.

name: Bone Axe
description: Axe of bones.

name: Boneaxe of Gorgorath
description: These warriors, loyal to the dragon Gorgorath, craft their weapons with the bones of the dragon's prey.

name: Bonebreaker of GrimSkull
description: GRIMSKULL HOPES YOU LIKE HIS GIFT.

name: Bonecrusher of GrimSkull
description: GRIMSKULL HOPES YOU LIKE HIS GIFT.

name: BoneCutter
description: With this massive weapon, Horcs are able to cut through bone and slice through sinew, destroying their enemies in one fell swoop!

name: Botanical Nightmare
description: You unlocked this sword by supporting Biobeasts! The trapped creatures of the lab thank you!

name: Braken Bass
description: 4 strings, 8 legs

name: Brase's Fireman Axe
description: A heavy titanium axe forged with void roentgenium ores, no enemy so far has been able to defend themselves from blows with the axe.

name: Bright Axe of Light
description: Using spells calling on the Light, these Battlemages are feared throughout the darker parts of Lore.

name: Bright Guardian's Axe
description: The white and gold regalia of the Bright Celestial Guardian is a mark of distinction for its bearer, signaling their supreme skill.

name: Bright Officer's Axe (Axe)
description: Whether you are a Paladin, Litch, BeastHunter, or Void HighLord… whatever class, role, or alignment you choose, it's important to take time to celebrate the holidays with your family and friends.

name: Bright Paladin's Axe
description: For junior paladins in training.

name: Bright Poleaxe of Light
description: Using spells calling on the Light, these Battlemages are feared throughout the darker parts of Lore.

name: Brisk Wind of Aeolus
description: Ice as hard as diamond, and as sharp as a knife can have only one use… to decimate your enemies!

name: Broken Horn Basher
description: … I think this creature's horns broke off from all the battles it's been in.

name: Bronze Crusher
description: This axe is the only one able to crush the very elements.

name: Brutal Axe of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, this axe was crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding it.

name: Brutality of the Darkblood
description: No one shall be left alive to speak of the massacre that had occurred. Only if they headed the warning of trespassing upon the city of Falguard.

name: Burger of Destiny
description: Following the great Undead Assault, Paladin Artix stopped to /rest and recharge his HP and MP by consuming the legendary Burger of Destiny!

name: Burning Battle Axe
description: Once a simple axe, a powerful caster put a spell causing the blade to glow.

name: Burning Light Of Destruction
description: Don't look directly at this axe… it is almost too hot to behold!

name: Calamitous Gilead Axe
description: A runed axe with the devastating potential to multiply its own magical powers. If its powers increase too much, it is said that it could turn Cataclysmic…

name: Candy Corn Crusher Axe
description: This candy corn was melted, molded, and tempered by the flames of a thousand jack-o-lanterns. It'll cut through bones, and shatter teeth.

name: Carnax Devotee's BattleAxe
description: The Alpha are a cult of psionic sorcerers whose leader created Carnax in another timeline. Your task is to do whatever you can to protect and defend this creature… no matter where or when it appears.

name: Carnicero Axe
description: The technology may evolve, but some things will never change.

name: Cataclysmic Gilead Axe
description: Corrupted by its own might, this ancient relic has begun to rip itself apart. Despite its unimaginable age, intensely vivid energy can still be seen flowing within.

name: Cavernous Carver Axe
description: Rough and rugged, you won't find many ornate weapons, only those use to fight.

name: Celestial Bard's Ukulele
description: The beauty of the stars enhances your creativity, and the music of the spheres flows through you.

name: Celestial Sand Axe
description: Forged by a clan of mages devoted to the Sandsea. Using their unique magics, they captured the heat of the desert sun in tangible form and tempered it with conjured sandstorms. The endless beating of the grains forced the axe into it's now lethal shape.

name: Cerberus Axe
description: The bestial guardian of the Underworld, Cerberus calls no man master. Use this axe wisely - it may not obey.

name: Cerise Crown Axe
description: The glowing eyes embedded in this axe's handle stare straight into your soul. If you don't look away, the weapon will take over and IT will wield YOU. PINK!

name: Chainbreaker Axe (AC)

description: When a Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, proving themselves unworthy, their successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Festive Light of Destiny (0 AC)
description: The Festive Light of Destiny is the perfect weapon for slayin' the undead, wreckin' the halls, and showing of your holiday spirit (orbs).

name: Festive Light of Destiny (AC)
description: The Festive Light of Destiny is the perfect weapon for slayin' the undead, wreckin' the halls, and showing of your holiday spirit (orbs).

name: Fieldy's Bass
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Fieldy!

name: Fiend's Draconic Trophy Axe
description: Given to you by Nulgath the ArchFiend himself, a reward for ridding his Nation of draconic traitors.

name: Fiend's Paladin Axe
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: Fiery Axe
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. This axe was made by calling and forging molten rock from volcanoes to come to the clans aid.

name: Firebird's Fury Great Axe
description: This axe, forged in the likeness of a great firebird, blazes with the heat of the rising sun. Only the worthy can wield the axe without it burning the skin off of their palms.

name: Firefighter Axe
description: No amount of heat will stop this axe from hitting its target!

name: Fishy Guitar
description: It is out of Tuna…

name: Flame Dragon Axe
description: Bestowed to those great warriors who have purchased Founder in AQ Dragons.

name: FlameBlade Axe
description: An axe burning with desire.

name: Flaming Naval Guitar
description: Blast them flamin' tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot…. ye can hear the booty callin', can't ye?

name: Flowing Axe
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. Harnessing the water, this axe slices through the air with surprising agility.

name: Force of Nature
description: SMASH! SMASH MORE! SMASH MOST!

name: Forest Axe
description: A very stylish axe great for chopping trees. Unfortunately it is no longer possible to MILK this weapon for gold.

name: Formal Light of Destiny
description: If you're going to be armed at your own wedding, do it in style. Fueled by Artix's love for Trini this Formal Light of Destiny does extra damage to undead.

name: Frazier Fury
description: Frazier Furs make great Frostval trees. The Frazier Fury makes great axes to cut down Frazier Furs.

name: Frightening Broad Axe
description: This frightening axe was crafted for Klunk by legendary weapon-smith, Kartos si Botax. Wield it well, hero! (This item has color customizable details.)

name: Frigid Bone Carver
description: The master of the FrostBlood is never the same for long, nor do they stay gentle or forgiving. Eventually, those claimed by the cold will be ordered to awaken, and spread the cold.

name: Frigid Destroyer
description: This axe's frosty blade will freeze and shatter even the sturdiest armor.

name: Frigid Wolf Axe (AC)
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frigid Wolf Axe (Non-AC)
description: The fangs of the North's beasts pierce flesh and freeze blood. When their teeth were fastened into this blade, the steel grew cold and the frigid winds blew.

name: Frost Dracolich Guard's Axe
description: Keep warm this holiday season in an extra warm armor - also good for protecting various body parts when dealing with dracoliches.

name: Frost Tiger Axe
description: In comparison to the honed claws of a predator, an axe can seem ungainly. It all comes down to the hand of the wielder. Skill is your greatest weapon.

name: Frostborn Throwing Axe
description: The kings and warlords of the Frostborn clan challenge each warrior to combat once a year. They celebrate each other's skill and the glory of battle itself.

name: Frostborn Warlord's BattleAxe
description: The kings and warlords of the Frostborn clan challenge each warrior to combat once a year. They celebrate each other's skill and the glory of battle itself.

name: Frostborn WolfRider's Axe
description: There are no lone Frostborn Wolves. The only thing deadlier than facing one in battle… is turning your back on a member of the pack. Each wields weaponry that can rip your throat out faster than you can scream.

name: Frostlorn Axe
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: Frostlorn Bear Rider Axe
description: This axe's jagged blade is the only thing more terrifying than the claws of northern bears.

name: FrostScythe's Axe
description: A heavy frigid axe that takes a great amount of strength to wield. It is incredibly powerful… if you can learn to fight with it.

name: Frostsworn Ice Axe (AC)
description: The icy wind isn't for the faint hearted. To reign in this frozen forsaken tundra you must have nerves of steel.

name: Frostsworn Ice Axe (Non-AC)
description: The icy wind isn't for the faint hearted. To reign in this frozen forsaken tundra you must have nerves of steel.

name: Frostval Barbarian Axe
description: During Frostval these nomadic wanderers from the north travel from town to town giving gifts and protecting those in need. You don't want to be on their naughty list though, else be on the receiving end of their most infamous gift - their pure rage.

name: Frozen Aurora Axe
description: This weapon was forged from light trapped inside Northlands crystals. Their reflection of the Aurora Borealis will mesmerize your enemies.

name: Frozen Axe
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: Frozen DragonFlame Axe
description: The gems in this axe are hot to the touch, and the obsidian blade still smells faintly of sulfur. Could DragonMaster Frostscythe have something to do with this?!

name: Frozen Hatred Poleaxe
description: Only those who can withstand the frozen North Mountain are bold enough to handle this polearm.

name: Frozen Light of Destiny
description: You've battled many monsters and saved Lore countless times! This replica of the famous axe was carved from ice to commemorate all your achievements and the many victories to come!

name: FrozenShard Axe
description: This blade has an enchanted ice shard in its core, and will transform when you press the gem in the center of its blades. Wield it well and wisely, hero, for it contains great magical power!

name: Furious Dragon Guitar
description: Rock on with this guitar until it starts a fire, Hero!

name: Galaxy Naval Guitar
description: Blast them starry tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot… ye can hear the booty callin', can't ye?

name: Gale Axe
description: With their mastery of the elements, the druids were able to craft powerful weapons. Harnessing the wind, this staff strikes faster than the eyes can follow.

name: Galvanic Tyrant
description: A huge axe that takes no prisoners. Raise it to the stormy skies, and steal its lightning. Carry the tempest in your hand, and make sure your enemies die screaming. That's the Lothian way.

name: Gargoyle Axe
description: Made from rough stone, but sharp as steel. Their origins are shrouded in mystery, but on some of them you can make out the word "Gargoyle".

name: Gears of Battle
description: It is said that heroes are just cogs in the machine of war. Whether or not that's true, now you have the gears of battle to grind down your foes!

name: Gem Axe of Selkis
description: This is a fan that's been repurposed into an axe. When Sek-Duat was still Pharaoh, he made his servants fan him with these heavy, gem encrusted implements. The last person who bonked him on the head by accident perished in agony.

name: General Porkon's Axe
description: This great axe is your prize for defeating one of the most feared warriors of Lore.

name: Giant VoidWarlord Axe
description: Ye need'd BIG weapons if ye be servin' the ArchFiend.

name: Gilded Axe of Honor
description: Grab your axe and go… because the time has come to ROCK the world of Lore, just like Synderes!

name: Gilded Ram Axe
description: Good for ramming your way into places

name: GL-1ST Salvage Axe
description: A weapon made from a droid's spare limb. Better this than nothing at all.

name: GL-24K Gilded Axe
description: Even if there are blaster guns available, some doors can only be opened the old fashioned way. It's way more satisfying too.

name: Glaceran War Axe
description: Blood freezes the moment you're cut on the planet of Glacera. Dissatisfied by this, many Warlords prefer the act of crushing - a far greater and far louder spectacle.

name: Glacial Light of Destiny
description: Battling undead through the frozen wastes, you draw strength from the otherworldly, shimmering light of the aurora borealis.

name: Glacial Troll Axe
description: When struck with this ice axe you'll need even more ice to combat the swelling.

name: Glowing Crown Axe
description: This axe's glowing blade is attuned to Light. But it was forged in order to destroy that Light which it found. If you are a Paladin, this it NOT the weapon for you!

name: Godly Golden Dragon Axe
description: Nulgath takes your signed contract in exchange for this impressive "Godly Golden Dragon Axe". You're excited yet uneasy, as Nulgath goes on to say, "Enjoy! As it states in the contract you signed, you can owe me later for this."

name: Gold Exalted Paladin Axe
description: Had Trolle'din had the improved version of this armor, it is doubtful that he would have perished. Then again, this IS Trolle'din we are talking about. He probably would have fallen for the same trick.

name: Gold Triumph Axe
description: A pure gold gift, forged in honor of your achievements and triumphs. Your Mage friends even put a spell on it. If the axe is stolen, the thief will be cursed for their greed. Fun!

name: Golden Axe of Kalestri
description: A cold-forged axe made in honor of the Goddess of death and decay. Because of the way the axe was forged it can hurt even ghosts and incorporeal spirits.

name: Golden Battle Axe
description: The blade of this axe shall protect all of the glory of Lore! All we need is a sword and a bow!

name: Golden Firebird's Poleaxe
description: This axe, forged in the likeness of a great firebird, blazes with the heat of the rising sun. Only the worthy can wield the axe without it burning the skin off of their palms.

name: Golden Leonides Axe (0 AC)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Golden Leonides Axe (AC)
description: The Lionisters of Swordhaven are an ancient and noble family. Their Frostval celebrations are legendarily gilded. Hear them ROAR!

name: Golden Monster Lord Axe
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monster may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Golden Throwing Axe
description: The kings and warlords of the Frostborn clan challenge each warrior to combat once a year. They celebrate each other's skill and the glory of battle itself.

name: Golden Warlord's BattleAxe
description: The kings and warlords of the Frostborn clan challenge each warrior to combat once a year. They celebrate each other's skill and the glory of battle itself.

name: Gormandized Fiend's Axe
description: A simple axe which, over time, has slain so many that the flesh of the wielder's enemies have begun to cling to the blade like a curse. For the wrathful of the Nation, it is a blessing.

name: GrandMaster Enchanted Axe
description: To become a GrandMaster it takes skill, a cunning eye, a sharp blade and a good fire retardant armor.

name: Graveclaw's Shatter-Axe
description: This axe thirsts for the head of King Alteon!

name: Graveclaw's Slayer
description: This axe thirsts for the head of King Alteon!

name: Graves End Axe
description: What awaits heroes at the end of the grave? No one knows.

name: Great Axe Of Eminence
description: The personal favorite weapon of the Titan, now used as an executioner's axe in the Phlegethon's dungeons. The Warden knows that it enrages the Titan. Building up its wrath will make its destructive outburst all the more devastating.

name: Greataxe of Castillonnais
description: An axe so heavy, it can cleave glaciers. Only a Chevalier and a steed of incredible strength can carry it into battle.

name: Greater Junkyard Pile o' Crap
description: This junk has melded and merged together and turned into this laser-bladed axe!

name: Green War Guitar
description: A deadly axe, ready to rip it up.

name: Grim Axe of Shadows
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the brighter parts of Lore.

name: Grim Bone Chopper
description: This terrifying weapon will make your enemies have a grim future.

name: Grim Poleaxe of Shadows
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the brighter parts of Lore.

name: GrimBlight of Destiny
description: We thought the Blinding Light of Destiny had been completely destroyed, but we were wrong. OOOHboy were we wrong. Evil hands have twisted it to their own sinister purposes… what those are, we do not yet know.

name: Grimskull Butchering Axe
description: Foolhardy adventurers are just asking to get chopped into mincemeat.

name: Grumble's Curse
description: Did this belong to Grumble? He has no arms… but his face does have some human characteristics.

name: Hack Past Insane
description: Forged from insanity and consumed by Chaos, this battle axe has no remorse for anyone foolish enough to get within striking distance. Including the wielder.

name: Halberd of Ulare
description: A weapon drenched in tears. Some are innocent. Others deserved three hacks of the axe. Either way, it curses all of its wielders, though some members of the Legion enjoy its burns.

name: Halcyon Coronation Axe
description: An axe that could cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies, meant for the hands of a true Hero and Champion. It lost its luster over time after being passed from a King to his descendants.

name: Halcyon Skye Axe
description: An axe that could cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies. They were meant for the hands of a true Hero and Champion. It passed from a King to his descendants, and lost its lustre.

name: Halcyon Skye Hand Axe
description: A prince lifted this axe, determined to rend the heavens just like his father. Gold spoiled into a morose gray in his hands. Dark clouds hung over the Kingdom for generations, until a worthy commoner revealed the weapon's true form.

name: Halcyon Virtue Axe
description: An axe that could cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies, meant for the hands of a true Hero and Champion. It lost its luster over time after being passed from a King to his descendants.

name: Half-Off Axe
description: This axe is half-off! Slay half the monsters in double the time!

name: Half-Off Light of Destiny
description: The other half of this BLoD replica broke off during a Black Friday bloodbath. Crazed shoppers are worse than any Chaos Lord.

name: Hand of Destruction (Axe)
description: An axe made from the arm of a worthy foe General Vaioh remembers fondly. He wasn't ready to let go of them, and jokes that the edge gets sharper the harder he holds their hand.

name: Handaxe of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Harvest Sickle
description: A small sickle for harvesting those hard-to-reach ingredients.

name: Havok
description: A destructive axe forged for the sole purpose causing as much damage as possible. The wielder must destroy something everyday with this weapon or be consumed by it.

name: Head's Guitar
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Head!

name: Heart Naval Guitar
description: Blast them loverly tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot… ye can hear the booty callin', can't ye?

name: Hearthside
description: Yulgar left this axe in the forge a LITTLE too long… and now it burns with great heat, even in the middle of winter. Warning: Yulgar's Inn does not assume any liability for burns caused by use of this axe.

name: Heartstone Axe
description: Just the right weapon for breaking someone's heart… by cutting it in two.

name: Heavy Celtic Axe
description: A ginormous pewter Celtic axe featuring a color custom accessory glow. No living thing could ever survive a blow from this monstrosity. Happy Lucky Day!

name: Heavy Metal Necromancer Guitar
description: A deadly axe on your back, ready to rip it up. (This item is color customizable)

name: Heavy Steampunk Axe
description: Tera Wind forged this massive battleaxe using steampunk technology. It is as much of a steampunk symbol as it is a ruthless display of power.

name: Heretic's Metal Axe
description: These ancient druid weapons were made in secret to combat supernatural beings. It was a crime amongst the ancient peoples to wield metal.

name: Heroic Berserker Axe
description: These Berserkers fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Heroic Berserker Hammer
description: These Berserkers fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: HighLord's BattleAxe of Destiny
description: This weapons was crafted to resemble Artix's Blinding Light of Destiny after he saved the paladin order from total destruction at the hands of Vordred, the Paladin Slayer. Take pride in your weapon and it will serve you well.

name: Hoarfrost Hatchet
description: A wicked looking hatchet carved from the body of an ice gaint, tipped with an ice dragon's fang, and fortified with steel. The perfect weapon to have with you when trying to survive a cataclysmic blizzard.

name: Hollow Draconian Axe
description: Long have the Draconians served as minions and fodder for the greats of Dragonkind. No longer will this stand. The Draconians will be vindicated, and the rest of Dragonkind will be butchered by their blades.

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Great-Axe (0 AC)
description: There's a tale of a Beastmaster dying as they stabbed their weapon into a massive behemoth's heart, and together, they overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial. Which weapon was it? Perhaps you're holding it in your hands. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn BeastMaster's Great-Axe (AC)
description: There's a tale of a Beastmaster dying as they stabbed their weapon into a massive behemoth's heart, and together, they overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial. Which weapon was it? Perhaps you're holding it in your hands. (Glow is customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Darkblood Axe
description: An ancient axe adorned with a face few Darkbloods can recognize. It comes from an era long lost, and their Hollowborn kin believe it should stay that way. They leave Falguard, and bring the past with them.

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Axe (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Axe (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Executioner's Axe
description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Executioner has mastered all types of combat. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Kama
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster. (Item does 30% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Hollowborn Shadow of Fate
description: You've battled many monsters, bosses, and even Death itself! The purest source of Light is now the mightiest weapons of the Shadows in your hands. May the Shadowfiend guide you along with this ultimate weapon.

name: Hollowborn Trainer's Axe
description: Don't mind the scratches, this weapon has been here for quite a while. Pity of your pupils, trainer. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Honor of Swordhaven
description: The people of Swordhaven trust and depend on your skill in battle to keep them safe.

name: Honored Gilded Axe
description: Gold extracted from the heart of the Dwarves mountain home isn't taken lightly. The detailing of this axe was made by the Dwarfhold Keep's elder council, and given to their most respected Heroes, Dwarven or otherwise.

name: Horc Grunt Axe
description: Crude but sturdy axe of the orc grunts.

name: Horc Mangler
description: This axe is made to rip and tear the Horc's enemies asunder.

name: Horcin' Hack 'n' Slash
description: A popular style of axe, the Horc Weaponsmaster learned this design from Cysero himself. The green-tinge in the metal pays homage to that

name: Horror's Cleaver
description: A ghastly axe whose blade was forged from solidified nightmares. Be a very cautious with this weapon, as it can cleave through friend and foe alike!

name: Horror Saw
description: Goes hand and saw with the Ebil-er Dread Paladin!

name: Hyphaxe
description: A mutagen hypha bacterium that is surrounded in a think thick, mucas mucus membrane. Yuck!

name: IceBreaker Axe
description: On the battlefield, wield this axe and bask in the wake on all the frozen lifeless bodies!

name: Icy Frostlorn Axe
description: The icy rift has spilled not only monsters into Lore, but also LOOT! Happy Frostval!

name: Icy Naval Guitar
description: Blast them icy tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot… ye can hear the booty callin', can't ye?

name: Idalion's ShadowCleaver
description: Its edge bears the mark of Idalion’s strike, a deep burn where dragonfire met steel, now turned into a weapon of defiance.

name: Ignus Axe (0 AC)
description: "Fire to strengthen, fire to blind, fire to scorch the unwary mind…" Ignus warriors draw strength from the barely-tamed molten trapped inside cooled lava rock.

name: Ignus Axe (AC)
description: "Fire to strengthen, fire to blind, fire to scorch the unwary mind…" Ignus warriors draw strength from the barely-tamed molten trapped inside cooled lava rock.

name: Imperial Kama
description: A farming implement with a razor-sharp blade, this can be wielded with deadly accuracy in the right hands.

name: Infection Cutter
description: That green stuff on the blade…. do NOT touch it!

name: Infernal Krampus' Claw
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off this claw. It is a testament to your victory in the Infernal Arena.

name: Inferno Nation Double Axe
description: A weapon that possesses the Fiend wielding it with an unceasing need for violence. The sound of these axes hacking away at bone echo through barren battlefields.

name: Infinity Titan Space Axe
description: The hardest choices requires the stronger will. The end is near, but you have the strength of will to act on those choices. Never forget.

name: Ionized TimeSplitter Axe
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Iron and Gold Axe
description: Iron and Gold have been combined in this axe to represent the best of Horc society.

name: Iron Maple Leaf Axe
description: The mighty axe of the north, forged deep in the Mounties.

name: Ivory Destroyer of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this axe using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Ivoryblood Battleaxe
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed-blood descendants.

name: Ivoryblood Great Axe
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed-blood descendants.

name: Ixionidae GravaCrusher
description: A noble golden blade that was once fused with a star, used to cleave comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae NeutroCrusher
description: A noble golden blade that was once fused with a star, used to cleave comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae StarCrusher
description: A noble golden blade that was once fused with a star, used to cull comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Jerry's Guitar
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Jerry!

name: Jewel of the Sea
description: Make 'em sleep with the fishes down in Davey Jones' locker!

name: Junkyard Doohickey
description: Rusted blades + broken propeller + gears and bits and doohickies = Propeller-bladed Axe of AeroDoom!

name: Juramento
description: We hope you enjoy watching as Diozz, one of Artix Entertainment's graphic artists, draws for you!

name: Kama
description: Okinawan and Japanese traditional farming implements similar to a sickle used for reaping crops and also employed as a weapon.

name: Karag Battleaxe
description: An axe that has seen many battles is a good axe to keep on hand! Forged long ago in Dwarfhold Keep.

name: Keytar
description: Embrace the power of the one true instrument. Rock on, keytarist virtuoso. Rock on.

name: Kh'arr Bludgeoner
description: Big skull means big smash. Three skulls mean BIGGER smash.

name: Khione's Curse
description: The Lady of Ice stalks the night, and those who fail to greet meet the edge of her cold, cursed blade.

name: King Dethrix's Axe
description: You DARE look me in the eye? Bow before your rightful sovereign. - King Dethrix Drakath

name: Krom's Conquest
description: This legendary axe has been wielded by the most battle hardened champions of Lore.

name: Lapis Crystal Axe
description: If the summer's excessive humidity deals damage to your HP, then an ice crystal scepter like this is ideal for cooling off and dealing with pesky fire elementals. Just don't stare too closely at its center.

name: Lavastorm Lord Scythe
description: Blaze forth with this lava infused axe.

name: Learning to Fly
description: In remembrance of Tom Petty… he was the King of the Heartbreakers.

name: Legion Blackwells Axe
description: This axe will send you straight to your maker if you happen to cross its path.

name: Legion Light of Destiny Axe
description: Following the great Undead Assault, the holy Axe of the Paladin Artix was cursed and infused with pure darkness to create the Shadow Reaper of Doom. Then Dage the Evil got ahold of it…

name: Legion Naval Guitar
description: Blast them undeadly tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot…. ye can hear the booty callin', can't ye?

name: Legion Skull Collector
description: Collecting heads and souls for the Undead Legion is every legionnaire's duty.

name: Legion Soul Splitter
description: Slice through your enemies as easily as Dage severs a spirit.

name: Legion Viking Big Axe
description: Destroy your enemies in the name of Dage the Evil, for YOU are a Legion Viking, and your enemies cower when they hear your battlecry!

name: Legion Viking Hatchet
description: Destroy your enemies in the name of Dage the Evil, for YOU are a Legion Viking, and your enemies cower when they hear your battlecry!

name: Leiron Lilies
description: A double-sided axe forged in the likeness of lilies. Lilies flourish within the Mudluk swamp, and you too will flourish as a hero with this weapon at your side.

name: Lesser Junkyard Gizmo
description: These blades were salvaged from inside an exploratory vehicle. They are razor-sharp, so make sure they are facing OUT when you equip this axe.

name: Leviathanius' Golden Axe
description: This gilded weapon was part of the Water Titan's closely-guarded treasure, kept safe deep under the waves until you defeated it.

name: Lich Bane
description: This golden axe is favored by paladins everywhere. The crown on the skull mocks lichs, most of whom wish to take over the world.

name: Lich's Earth Axe
description: ICE ICE BABY.. Rock.. Rock baby… ?

name: Lich Slayer
description: A heavy, deadly battleaxe forged from bonesteel, this weapon was created for the elite Necropolis Campus Guard.

name: Life Giver Axe
description: This glittering golden blade symbolizes the powerful warriors of the Swordhaven Court. Use it well in combat.

name: Light of Digital Destiny
description: Artix's axe in pixelated form! Perfect for slaying undead pixels.

name: Lion's Bloodrage
description: The axe's blades are styled to look like the bloodied mane of a victorious lion. It sinks its teeth into the skulls of the defeated.

name: Liquid Hot Magma Axe
description: Extracted from the pits of the Vasalkar Lair, this axe will keep hot for the next ten thousand years. (Warning: Keep out of rain.)

name: Lithium Lily
description: Forged from lithium, this blade is crafted in the likeness of the lily flower, symbolizing the Mudluk's devotion of protecting the swamp.

name: Little Hatchet
description: You're definitely not gonna intimidate an orc warlord with this.

name: Loathing of Múspell
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Loathing of Surtr
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Love Bard's Guitar
description: Music can be so romantic, don't you think?

name: Lovely Axe
description: The rosy golden glow of this gorgeous axe will mesmerize… well, whoever you're hacking at.

name: Lumberhorc's Maple Leaf Axe
description: The mighty axe of the north, forged for the massive Lumberhorc.

name: Lumberjack Axe
description: Super effective against rebellious trees! Happy Mogloween!

name: Lumenomancer's Woe
description: Even the warriors of the Light fall to desperate measures sometimes.

name: Lumiel Spinsaw

name: Melee Mosher Axe

name: Meteoric Crescent Axe

name: Mi's Rainbow Guitar

name: Mudluk Monster Axe

name: Munky's Guitar

name: Mystery Moon Axe

name: Mystic Tribal Axe

name: Nation Dragonbane Cleaver (0 AC)
description: Dragons are a uniquely powerful lifeform, blessed with power and purpose - perfect for the Fiends to devour and use. Members of the Nation seek to slay them and use their parts to make weapons that embody their might.

name: Near

name: Necrowave Axe

name: Nerfed Blinding Light of Destiny

name: Nightcleaver

name: Nightlocke War Axe

name: Nightmare Carnax's BattleAxe

name: Nightshock Axe

name: Not so nICE Axe

name: Obsidian Paladin Naval Axe

name: Occam's Razor Axe
description: A well-known detective aphorism states: "When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth."

name: Octopus Guitar
description: Ye need EIGHT arms to play this guitar, heyooooo!

name: One Eyed Axe
description: A true instrument of terror! This rare weapon was discovered during the live One-Eyed Doll event.

name: One-Eyed Axe of Agony
description: A rockin' One-Eyed Doll axe that gives a more than literal meaning of the phrase "a fan until the day I die." Let the legend live on as you Battle On!

name: Orc's Axe
description: This great axe is your prize for defeating one of the most feared warriors of Lore.

name: Overdriven Paladin's Crusher
description: So this is what happens to Paladins when they draw too much of the power of the Light. But the light promised the worthy would be able to survive. Guess they weren't worthy enough.

name: Oversoul Axe Of Valdis
description: Valdis, Legendary Vampire Knight of the Oversoul, says "A pleasure to meet you. It's a shame you'll have to leave this world so soon."

name: Oversoul Guard's Axe
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend rules the OverSoul, and in the heart of his realm lies the Minotaur's Labryrinth. This battlegear was taken from its guards after they fell in its defense.

name: Oversoul's Rusted Head Axe
description: An axe needs a sharp edge on its head if it's going to be of any use to you.

name: P'AXE
description: Artix and the crew are at the PAX: East 2023 convention to demo AdventureQuest Worlds: Infinity, a cross-platform remake of our 2D MMORPG. This axe is a reward for all heroes attending (..and anyone else who learns the super-secret code!)

name: Painadin Shadowreaper of Doom
description: Painadin Overlords are a powerful asset in Alteon's army. Their axes are coated in poison from RedDeath Swamp, to speed up their victim's conversion to Alteon's army.

name: Paladin's Pride
description: Paladins rise… and rise again!

name: Passionate Axe of Friendship
description: Watch this glowing heart blade slice through the air, decimating lackluster passion and hatred. Merely holding this axe will inspire love, poetry and sonnets. Beware, though, as others may just flock to you.

name: Penumbra Pumpkin Axe
description: An eldritch touch made humble pumpkins evolve, and fostered a hunger for supremacy. Smash the competition! There's only room for one to grow!

name: Peril
description: Use your Good nature and this gleaming gold blade to defend and assist the innocent! Protect those who can't help themselves and you will be rewarded!

name: Permafrost Axe (0 AC)
description: Frost Shamans draw their power from energy contained in the permafrost. Frozen magic lays dormant under the ice in the Northlands, waiting for a powerful enough magician to tap it.

name: Permafrost Axe (AC)
description: Frost Shamans draw their power from energy contained in the permafrost. Frozen magic lays dormant under the ice in the Northlands, waiting for a powerful enough magician to tap it.

name: Permafrost Light of Destiny
description: You've battled many monsters and saved Lore countless times! This replica of the famous axe was carved from ice to commemorate all your achievements and the many victories to come!

name: Phoenix Temper and Revenge
description: Featuring dual blades forged to look like phoenix brothers, this axe works best in the hands of those with an undying temper. A rare weapon discovered around the time of the PTR release.

name: Pink Reaper Of Doom

name: Piston-Driven Chopper

name: Platinum Axe of Destiny
description: A gift from Artix for helping test something big.

name: Platinum Axe of Rechord
description: What else were you supposed to do with so many Platinum Records laying around? You won't miss a beat with this axe!

name: Platinum Broad Axe
description: The razor-sharp battleaxe of the Platinum Knights is highly effective against any opposing foe.

name: Platinum DragonAxe of Victory +15
description: Your character creation sheet should read: +15 for your axe, +20 for your int, and +100 for being as cool as you are for playing AQW!!!!

name: Platinum Naval Guitar
description: Blast them shiny tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot…. ye can hear the booty callin', can't ye?

description: Only the heartiest heroes are BRRRR-ave enough to sail the frozen seas that border the Northlands!

name: Polar Naval's Hatchet (AC)

name: Polished Blinding Light of Destiny
description: BLoD is all polished and ready to go!

name: Possessed Spiritual Axe (AC)
description: Countless spirits are sealed in this blade whose names have been cruely taken from them. Their restless anguish sharpens its cruel edge.

name: Primal Tiger Axe
description: In comparison to the honed claws of a predator, an axe can seem ungainly. It all comes down to the hand of the wielder. Skill is your greatest weapon.

name: Primaris Paladin's Axe
description: No matter how vast your enemies, shielded by the symbol of your order, you battle without fear. Your current mission: to guard the guardians fighting to defend Battleon from the Titans.

name: Prime Sheer Insanity
description: Insanity is contagious.

name: Primitive Bone Axe
description: When you wield this wicked weapon, your enemies are boned!

name: Prisma Ram Axe
description: The horn of a beast, heavy and frought with gnarls, that fought bloody battles to become lord of a mountain. Lost to the depths, its weapons have now become yours. (CC to Base)

description: This color-custom axe, laced with the bones of bones of your past trophies, will be the perfect tool for skinning the wings off of dragons!

name: Prismatic Soul Render

name: Prismatic War Axe

name: Prized Tomahawk of the Revered
description: A prized tomahawk awarded to revered Native Lorian Chiefs back in the days. This rare weapon was discovered around the time of the PTR release.

description: The not-so-mystical axe possesses a snake-like appearance for its watchful eye. The ominous appearance of the axe is not so dissimilar to a colossal icy snake that was petrified into a treelike formation many years ago. Could it be that this same snake is watching you through the single eye of that axe?

name: Purified Chrono Axe (0 AC)
description: The components of this temporal axe were taken from a titanic timekeeper. Each gear diligently revolves, serving a higher purpose.

description: The components of this temporal axe were taken from a titanic timekeeper. Each gear diligently revolves, serving a higher purpose.

name: Pyroclastic BeastMaster's Great-Axe (0 AC)
description: In the claws of beasts that sleep in the depths of volcanoes are armanents from ages past. The beasts often outlive their former mortal masters, and wait for a day when a new partner steps fearlessly into magma.

name: Quattro Cleaver
description: When two blades just aren't enough… Take this axe to town and hit twice the enemies for quadruple the fun.

name: Raxborg's Axe
description: ﻿Greater levels of cruelty can only be achieved with red hot lasers. Not blue. Not green. It has to be red. Yes, it matters!

name: Salvage
description: The tiny cleric on this sword will gladly cut your enemies with his resplendent golden wings.

name: Scarmiglione Cleaver
description: Perfect for cutting tomatoes, bread, enemies.

name: Scarsgarde Captain's Axe
description: The last line of defense for Scarsgarde, they fight the Captain fights to protect the Keep!

name: Scorched Ice Axe
description: Harden from years spent in the bitter cold, this axe would not melt even in the fires of Mount Mafic.

name: Season's Beatings Candyhawk
description: Take your revenge by beating down your enemies with the tastiest, sweetest— yet deadliest axe crafted from Frostval's candies… now comes with spearmint flavor!

name: Septaxe of Air
description: The breath of the Lore's greatest gods is contained inside the center of this septaxe. With their blessing, venture forth into battle!

name: Septaxe of Earth
description: The Eldest of the Nature Spirits has looked on this axe with favor. In your hands, this weapon will pulse with the power of earth!

name: Septaxe of Fire
description: Your opponents will be hypnotized by the dancing of the flames while you cleave through the their ranks to emerge victorious in battle!

name: Septaxe of Water
description: Inside even the greatest of maelstroms is a point of calm. Find that center inside yourself as you wield this axe and you will become a greater warrior than you ever imagined!

name: Seraph's Axe

name: Seraphic Fourth Axe
description: When a member of the Seraphic Order falls, their cybernetic enhancements are taken. They're turned into weapons until they resonate with someone worthy to be fused with them.

description: Hysterical Blindness is a psychological affliction that occurs when the victim seems something so mindbogglingly traumatizing, he or she is struck with blindness. How do you think this axe got its name?

description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took off his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Light Axe
description: One of the prizes from for the Roach Races - an awesome Silver Axe!

name: Silver War Guitar
description: A deadly axe, ready to rip it up.

name: Skele-crystal Cleaver

name: Skulls and Doom Guitar
description: Skulls and bones and ROCK AND ROLL! Happy Friday the 13th, Hero!

name: Skulls of the Misfortunate
description: BEWARE! If you enter the Blackhorn Tombs, prepare to forfeit your life…and your skull!
