description: No one expects the cutest heroes to be the deadliest.

name: Sol Imperator
description: An axe tempered by flames from distant nebulas, forged with the intent to burn hotter than the sun. This creation is highly unstable, but its wielder doesn't care if it reduces everything to ash, so long as they shine the brightest.

name: Solstice Blood Axe
description: In the far reaches of the universe, the Fiend's Void swallowed dying suns. Their energy still ripples through the Abyss, and Archfiends harnessed the lost rays to forge devastating weapons.

name: Soulborne Axe
description: The "soul" of this axe might just try to posses you.

name: SoulCrusher of Nulgath Hammer (0 AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: SoulCrusher of Nulgath Hammer (AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: Sovereign's Anomalous Severance
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Space-timeless Axe
description: Time is cyclical… who knows from where (or when?) the Chronocide got these weapons. Doesn't matter - it's yours now!

name: Sphinx's Secret Axe
description: I SURE HOPE THIS DOESN'T MAKE ANYONE A-SPHINX-IATE!

name: Spinal Tap Axe
description: An axe made of sharpened bone. What part of the body is this bone even from, anyway?

name: Spooky Axe
description: *Spooky music plays as fog creeps over the playground* O_O

name: Sput's Really Big Cleaver
description: It not THAT big. Me seen bigger.

name: Star Light of Destiny
description: The might of the heavens is in your hands. Your foes have nowhere to escape, for even the darkest nights are under the dominion of the stars. (Changes in Combat)

name: Star Light of the Empyrean
description: The might of the heavens is in your hands. Your foes have nowhere to escape, for even the darkest nights are under the dominion of the stars. (Changes in Combat)

name: Steampunk Hatchet
description: For those really stubborn eggs.

name: Steel Slicer
description: Great for deli workers and Skyguard recruits alike! Slice into your foes; turn them into mincemeat! (Although, really, mincemeat is more chopped than sliced. But just go with it.)

name: Stella Empyrean Axe
description: Of the twenty-eight stars that fused into the Nova Empyrean, some have broken away to form a weapon. The heavens cling to your arms, wishing to learn from your trials and tribulations.

name: Strong Axe of Golmoth
description: The Dragon Princes of the Djinn Realm are feared among all of the draconic species on Lore. They possess a power rarely seen in our world… and not at all understood.

name: Sub-Zero Axe
description: Introduce your enemies to the big chill known as their ice graves!

name: Sub-Zero Hatchet
description: Send your enemies into their frosty grave with this tomahawk!

name: Summer Sear Axe (0 AC)
description: It radiates intense heat, as if you pulled it out of the sun itself. Warning, please handle with gloves.

name: Summer Sear Axe (AC)
description: It radiates intense heat, as if you pulled it out of the sun itself. Warning: please handle with gloves.

name: Swanhild's Vengeance (0 AC)
description: Upon the unhonorable slaying of their kin, all members of the Frostlorn Clan are duty-bound to take brutal revenge. The snow will fall red upon the defiler's lands forevermore.

name: Swanhild's Vengeance (AC)
description: Upon the unhonorable slaying of their kin, all members of the Frostlorn Clan are duty-bound to take brutal revenge. The snow will fall red upon the defiler's lands forevermore.

name: Swordhaven Axe
description: An elite axe of Axehav…errr.. Swordhaven.

name: Swordhaven Master Axe
description: An elite axe of Axehav….errr..Swordhaven. This axe does more damage against humans.

name: Synderes Acoustic Guitar
description: Rock on as you make the choice between good and evil!

name: Synderes Electric
description: Grab your axe and go… because the time has come to ROCK the world of Lore, just like Synderes!

name: Tattooed Electric Guitar
description: Such an epic looking guitar! Sounds good, too!

name: Tattooed Electric Guitar Attack
description: Such an epic looking guitar! Sounds good, too!

name: Tears Of Joy
description: SHOUT! SHOUT! Let all the blood out!

name: Techno Light of Destiny
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Techno Paladin's Battle Axe
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Techno Paladin's Poleaxe
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: Techno Wanderer's Poleaxe
description: The power of Time powers these Chronomancers as they travel the length and breadth of Lore, always searching for those in need.

name: TechnoEdge Axe
description: This axe will give anyone an edge in battle, in the Mirror Realm in our world!

name: TechnoLight of Destiny
description: You've battled many monsters and saved Lore countless times! This replica of the famous axe was found in a galaxy far, far away, and must be clicked to activate.

name: TechnoReaper of D00m
description: DoomKnights never give up. Never give in. And NEVER bow to anyone.

name: TechtronAxe of Triumph
description: A creative weaponmaker by trade, Shaister1 decided to forge this devastating axe. Using pulse energy, this axe's blade will never dull but just remember to recharge it before entering battle.

name: Temporal Triune Axe
description: I once read that 3 heads were better than 2. So I guess this axe is better than an axe with 2 heads. And REALLY better than an axe with 1 head. Don't even get me started with an axe with NO heads.

name: Temporal Triune Axe +3
description: I once read that 3 heads were better than 2. So I guess this axe is better than an axe with 2 heads. And REALLY better than an axe with 1 head. (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Tharr's Double-Axe
description: A legendary Warrior from the OverSoul, Tharr followed Nulgath the ArchFiend through the portal. His goal: to find new battlefields to conquer and opponents to crush.

name: The Axe from the Grave
description: This axe will punch your foe's one way ticket into the afterlife.

name: The Axe of Selfless and Greed
description: Constructed using both light and dark magic, this magical weapon harnesses the users aurora to inflict a force that can shake this very realm.

name: The Frost Axe
description: Happy Frostval! The might of ice sure cools off your opponent!

name: The Great Divider
description: Two huge, heavy blades that can split apart wood, stone, steel and bone. A dangerously powerful weapon.

name: The Great Gilead Axe
description: An ancient axe once treasured by the Gilead people. Its legendary power is only matched by its craftsmanship.

name: This Might Be an Axe
description: This might be an axe you can wield in battle!

name: Tide of the Darkblood
description: A double-ended weapon, Tide of the Darkblood is great for dispatching foes that attack from either side. A storm is coming, will your enemies know what hit them?

name: TimeReaper Axe
description: Where Drakath goes the TimeReapers follow. Have to help keep the timelines clean!

name: Tlax's Axe
description: This is the battle axe of Tlax, the Horc Battlemaster. After finding a rare Rhison Horn for him, he gifted it to you.

name: TomaHawk
description: A variation of tomahawk created for the Royal Falconers of Swordhaven.

name: Torrential Nautica Axe
description: Make sure you hit from the right angle. The snail that lives in that shell would be upset with you if you smashed his home.

name: Tourmaline Pickaxe
description: Relics from a lost society, these pickaxes belonged to the Tourmaline Elven Clan who use to dwell in the forest before it was corrupted by Chaos. Now all that is left from this great race are these legendary weapons.

name: Toxic Deadmoor BattleAxe
description: Mallora's scream cursed this axe long ago. The dark magic has aged in a force only a fool would unleash.

name: Tracker Axe
description: This axe were created from the tears and fears of EbilCorp's sweatshop workers. Somehow Chairman Platinum figured out a way to harness the energy from the sweatshop workers' demons and make a physical axe out of them! Death to all that inhabit Lore!

name: Tribal SkinWalker's Axe
description: With the ability to turn into any animal at all, SkinWalkers have been around for thousands of years, lurking in the shadows of the forest.

name: Triceriaxe
description: Send your foes into extinction with one massive swing of the Triceriaxe!

name: Trophy Hunter Axe
description: As you rack up the kills, your armor evolves into an intimidating, yet strangely compelling display of your trophies.

name: Trophy Hunter Axe Advanced
description: As you rack up the kills, your armor evolves into an intimidating, yet strangely compelling display of your trophies.

name: Trophy Hunter Axe Evolved
description: As you rack up the kills, your armor evolves into an intimidating, yet strangely compelling display of your trophies.

name: Trophy Taker
description: What you see is what you'll get… once you take it!

name: TurkeyHawk
description: This prized and greatly adorned tomahawk was a gift from Native Lorian Chiefs to the Battleon Pilgrims during Lore's first Thanksgiving.

name: Turquoise Battle-Axe
description: Turquoise is a protective stone and is often ground up in potions used to enhance warding spells. This weapon has been coated in a potion thick with Turquoise dust.

name: Twisted Eldritch Axe
description: The deepest depths hide some of the strangest and most dangerous beasts.

name: Two-handed Axe
description: It a double bladed, two handed, axe.

name: Ultima Geoda
description: One of the Ultima Elemental weapons, this battleaxe calls forth the might of the earth to smite your foes like a landslide, overcoming them with brute force.

name: ULTIMA VORDREAD AXE (0 AC)
description: A FINE SKULL CRUSHER…BUT I NEED SKULLS TO BE INTACT IF I'M GOING TO WEAR THEM. OH WELL. SALLY'S GOOD WITH GLUE.

name: ULTIMA VORDREAD AXE (AC)
description: A FINE SKULL CRUSHER…BUT I NEED SKULLS TO BE INTACT IF I'M GOING TO WEAR THEM. OH WELL. SALLY'S GOOD WITH GLUE.

name: Ultimate Blinding Light of Destiny
description: Stellaria isn't the only Rainbow Paladin in Lore's Future. Shine on!

name: Ultra Elemental Axe
description: This axe is made of solidified versions of Lore's elements! It can smash through… ANYTHING!

name: Unbreakable Promise Great Axe
description: Every vow and promised made while this axe is raised will be eternal.(Click gem to transform)

name: Unbridled Rage
description: When you no smash, try slash.

name: Unchained Rocker's Attack Guitar
description: Unchained Rockers are a force to be reckoned with in a mosh pit. Like the band, they're die hard fans of, they utilize their deathly riffs, mighty voices, and necromantic abilities to crush their foes into submissions.

name: Unchained Rocker's Guitar
description: Unchained Rockers are a force to be reckoned with in a mosh pit. Like the band, they're die hard fans of, they utilize their deathly riffs, mighty voices, and necromantic abilities to crush their foes into submissions.

name: Undead Assault Axe (Axe)
description: Time to hack and slash your way through undead, make Artix proud! Released in honor of Artix Entertainment's new mobile game "Undead Assault"

name: Undead Glow Guitar
description: Blast the tunes, ye scurvy sea-dawgs! We need to ROCK the BOAT as we hunt for loot… ye can hear the booty callin' can't ye?

name: Undead Infantry Axe
description: Unknowing of the evil that stands in their path, they continue on as Dage the Evil commands them to.

name: Undead Pirate Guitar
description: Dead men sing no songs.

name: Undead Slasher Axe
description: Dage wants YOU to join the Undead Legion!

name: Underworld DeathEater Axe (0 AC)
description: Underworld ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Underworld DeathEater Axe (AC)
description: Underworld ShadowReavers serve Empress Gravelyn with complete and unbreakable loyalty. They have NEVER been known to break their vow to the darkness.

name: Underworld General Axe (0 AC)
description: To gain access to the Underworld you must defeat one of the many Generals which roam the forsaken land looking for souls to harvest.

name: Underworld General Axe (AC)
description: To gain access to the Underworld you must defeat one of the many Generals which roam the forsaken land looking for souls to harvest.

name: Underworld Heretic Axe (0 AC)
description: They may follow Nulgath but they don't believe in everything he does.

name: Underworld Heretic Axe (AC)
description: They may follow Nulgath but they don't believe in everything he does.

name: Underworld Nemesis Kama
description: The Underworld Nemesis is one denizen of the darkness you do NOT want to meet without a battle companion by your side and a blessed blade in your hand.

name: Underworld Shrade Axe
description: Shrade now finds himself in Dage's realm.

name: Vaioh's Creed
description: Axes named after a powerful General of the Shadowscythe. The warriors fighting in his shadow model themselves after him, turning worthy enemies into weapons that will never leave their side.

name: Valaska
description: The perfect tool for chopping wood… or making sure your enemies will never AXE you a question again.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Axe (0 AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vanta Shadow Knight's Axe (AC)
description: The black knight from AdventureQuest 3D has broken through the barriers of space, time, and technology to make its way here, into our world.

name: Vengeance of Nulgath Axe
description: Warriors who betray Nulgath the ArchFiend have their minds blasted clean. They are rebuilt from the ground up to serve only him, forever, body and mind. The loss of their personality and "self" is Nulgath's ultimate punishment.

name: Verde Crystal Axe
description: If the summer's excessive humidity deals damage to your HP, then an ice crystal scepter like this is ideal for cooling off and dealing with pesky fire elementals. Just don't stare too closely at its center.

name: Vestal Gold Axe
description: An axe to fell spirals of centuries, able to easily cleave the trees of Doomwood before darkness fell. Now, it cuts steel and bone. The Undead and the Paladins who fight them are its master's enemies.

name: Vibrant Axe of Golmoth
description: The Dragon Princes of the Djinn Realm are feared among all of the draconic species on Lore. They possess a power rarely seen in our world… and not at all understood.

name: Vindicator Titan's Axe
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. Vindication will be yours! BATTLE ON!

name: Violent Axe of Friendship
description: Watch this glowing heart blade slice through the air, decimating lackluster passion and hatred. Merely holding this axe will inspire love, poetry and sonnets. Beware, though, as others may just flock to you.

name: Virtuous Chaooze Axe
description: The chaotic ooze covering the blade of this axe obscures its golden blade, making it impossible to tell from its evil counterpart.

name: Viscyra's Axe
description: Only the most loyal of Lascivia's devotee's receive gifts such as this.

name: Void Destruction Axe
description: A weapon Nythera crafted with magic, and the materials she found in her travels through the Void. Dragons shiver at the sight of it, unable to discern fear and familiarity.

name: Void Light of Destiny
description: Thought you could use this axe to heal others? HA! It's infused with the Archfiend's power. It harms people, it doesn't heal them!

name: Void Overlord's Axe
description: From the depths of Tercessuinotlim, there were always whispers of a Void so powerful, only Nulgath himself knew of their existence. Now they've come out of the shadows.

name: Void Overlord's Dual-Bladed Axe
description: From the depths of Tercessuinotlim, there were always whispers of a Void so powerful, only Nulgath himself knew of their existence. Now they've come out of the shadows.

name: Void Reaver
description: A twisted form of what used to be a monster dwelling in the Void. Luckily it's not breathing… right?

name: Void Walker Axe
description: To travel between the Void and the real world isn't easy. The Void is filled with treacherous being awaiting prey.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote Battleaxe (0 AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote Battleaxe (AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: VoidWarlord of Nulgath Axe (1)
description: Chop chop chop, I like to chop.

name: VoidWarlord of Nulgath Axe (2)
description: Chop chop chop, I like to chop.

name: Volcanic Fire Axe
description: Fighting fire with fire would be an issue if Dwarven handles weren't built to survive the sun. Your opponent's face has nowhere near that resistance, so this axe will do a great job of burning that.

name: Voltaire's Guitar (Axe)
description: It's the same one he plays on stage with! When he plays his guitar you can /dance2 it.

name: Voltaire's Vorutanian Key Blade
description: A powerful item given from Voltaire to you! Who knows what secrets it's powers will unlock!

name: Vordred's Shadow Axe of Destiny
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS. (CC to Base and Accessory)

name: Vorutanian Key Blade
description: The evil Lord Krom Wrath searched the universe for this very special object of power. Now that YOU have it, keep it safe and wield it well!

name: WardKeeper's War Axe
description: This magnetic hatchet is capable of drawing power from the moon when it is at its highest during the night and can store a great deal of its energy for a long period of time, allowing its user to endure long-lasting days.

name: WarForge Tank Axe (0 AC)
description: When they join the Legion's march, the Warforge Tanks are frequently targetted for the weapons being tempered in their bodies. Thieves beware. Their axes will find your necks.

name: WarForge Tank Axe (AC)
description: When they join the Legion's march, the Warforge Tanks are frequently targetted for the weapons being tempered in their bodies. Thieves beware. Their axes will find your necks.

name: Warlock of Love Axe
description: In all this world, you might be happy, genuinely happy. Not one couple in a century has that chance, not really, but you could have it.

name: WarSeeker's Axe (AC)
description: The war cry for these crusading Legionnaires is "For power! For combat! For Dage!"

name: WarSeeker's Axe (Special)
description: The war cry for these crusading Legionnaires is "For power! For combat! For Dage!"

name: Wave of Dispair
description: The enormous, heavy blades of this axe will keep you r enemy at bay. For those who decide who decide to attack anyway, they will meet a watery, cold death without hope of rescue.

name: Weaponsmith's Battle Axe
description: Forged by Mastersmith Yohann to help the heroes of Lore battle to victory, this axe will never break…. as long as you are true to your cause (whatever it may be)!

name: Weeping Axe of DOOM
description: Nothing strikes fear into the hearts of your enemies quite like an axe that is crying for their souls. Literally. Crying.

name: Werebear Axe
description: A tough and sturdy weapon to fight off intruders.

name: What Made the Horseman
description: Off with Crane's head!

name: White Electric Guitar
description: Classic white electric guitar. Play it loud!

name: White Electric Guitar Attack
description: Classic white electric guitar. Play it loud!

name: Wicked Chaooze Axe
description: The chaotic ooze covering the blade of this axe obscures its blade made of pure black obsidian, making it impossible to tell from its good counterpart.

name: Wicked Guitar
description: When music collides with ferocity, the Wicked Guitar is born! One rockin' design inspired by dage666 Dage the Evil.

name: William's Guitar
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as William!

name: Winter Legion Warrior Axe
description: The Winter Legion Warriors are renowned for battling through the darkest night and harshest blizzards. They are so dedicated, they will keep fighting beyond life itself. Those are the most desirable soldiers for the Legion to recruit.

name: Winter Sign Axe
description: Monasteries have armories that are only to be opened when the monks need to defend themselves. While some see meaning in war, those who meditate in the cold see little meaning in staining red snow when it'll eventually melt.

name: WinterWild Axe
description: Pledge your life and honor to the defense of Coldwind Valley, for this winter and all winters to come.

name: Unidentified 14 (Worn Axe)
description: Swindle says, well this "Worn Axe" has seen better days. It's still quite deadly I bet.

name: Wraith Axe
description: At first glance, this appears to be a can of mens deodorant. But when you Click to Activate it, out pops an Axe!

name: Wrath of the Werepyre
description: Just in case ominous wings and 6-inch canine fangs weren't enough to scare away mortals, Werepyres now have a backup plan: this axe!

name: Wrathful Nightmare Axe
description: An old nightmare has taken a new form with sharper edges. This time, it won't be forgotten.

name: Yokai Lute (Axe)
description: An ancient Lute that produces a beautiful melody, whether or not the user is musically talented. It also makes for a great Jeminiweapon!

name: Zealous Light of Fate
description: Warriors for Good in the time of Stellaria, these Paladins went fearlessly into battle against the Cryptborg's forces of NecroDrones and NecroMechs. There… they met their fate. Do not let their sacrifice be in vain!

name: Zhilo's Axe
description: A time-tested axe, dented and worn with the stress of hundreds of battles. A trusted companion to Zhilo, this axe now resides with you. May it see another hundred battles and more.

name: Zwamborn
description: A massive battleaxe of immeasurable power passed down from warrior to warrior, through battle, for centuries.
